scope: Named mathematical mechanisms read at primary sources; no independent domain specialist review

uses.support: Sparse selection and normalized expert mixtures
uses.limit: The atlas fits two scalar regressors with an authored gate; it does not reproduce the paper’s learned gate or reported language results.

uses.support: Recurrence and convolution representations of a linear state-space computation
uses.limit: The scalar teaching recurrence has no structured S4 parameterization, trained kernel or reported long-sequence result.

uses.locator: Definition of valid 2D cross-correlation and output shape
uses.support: A valid local cross-correlation produces a smaller output grid
uses.limit: The two filters and input images are authored; PyTorch is not executed in the browser.

uses.support: Negative-exponent discrete Fourier transform and default forward normalization
uses.limit: The atlas directly sums 32 terms; it does not execute an FFT library or report a PSD.

uses.support: Symmetric Hann window uses N−1 in its cosine denominator
uses.limit: The finite window does not restore frequencies already lost by sampling.

uses.locator: Sections 2–3, forward marginal and reverse-process equations
uses.support: Variance schedule, noisy marginal and epsilon-parameterized reverse mean
uses.limit: The atlas substitutes a nonparametric scalar regressor and finite schedule; the source does not validate its sample quality.
